intention: `cairn recordverdict` — the gate act fired from the gate owner's OWN SHELL: a bin/cmd door wrapping learning_block.record_verdict. It must indicate WHICH thing the verdict is for: with more than one finding in flight, the command takes the block/finding it judges; with exactly one pending, naming it may be optional but the record always carries it. An ambiguous act is refused with the candidates LISTED (the named-lack pattern) — never guessed. Signal (approve|disprove|question) + Akien's words ride as arguments; the record lands through the primitive's sole write path, nothing new touches CairnCommons/learning/ directly. AMENDED 2026-08-01 at Akien's order ('i still want /recordverdict but more importantly, we'll need to automate this gating process. … approved, go go go!'): the build is now CURRENT, and the door grows the automation half — (a) `cairn recordverdict` bare LISTS what stands at his gate (pending findings: emitted, no verdict yet) with their bullets; (b) the session-open surface adds an AT-YOUR-GATE lane so pending findings reach him without anyone remembering to ask; (c) the gate name is DERIVED from the finding's block, never typed — the 2026-08-01 mislabel (gate-record lb-20260801-f4f21cbb wrote gate='akien' where the block name was the convention) is the measured defect this kills.

watchme: none, because gate acts are already watched where they matter: the sibling migration ticket's WATCHME(akien-gate-dial) reads every verdict recorded through the primitive, and this door is a hand on an existing organ, not a new gate. Its own proof gate covers correctness.
falsifier: RED, by physics, on any of: (1) with multiple findings pending, the command records a verdict without the target named — or refuses without LISTING the candidates; (2) a verdict lands with empty or CC-authored words where Akien's verbatim belongs; (3) the door writes to CairnCommons/learning/ by any path other than learning_block.record_verdict (a second writer, the validation-store trouble's shape); (4) an invented finding id is accepted rather than refused against the trace berth's actual contents.
horizon: Re-read when it builds: if by then delegation has begun (edge c), the door needs the inspector-verdict path too — decide then, not now.
distinctions_recorded: NOT URGENT IS SCOPE, NOT SILENCE: the lack is filed (charter edge g) and ticketed the same day it was discovered; only the BUILD waits. The third path — flagged and landing nowhere — is the defect this system names.

THE TARGET REQUIREMENT IS THE MULTI-FLIGHT REQUIREMENT: today one finding pends and zero ambiguity exists; the door is specified for the world Akien predicts ('sooner or later we will have more than one thing in flight'), so the refusal-with-candidates is in the falsifier from birth.
